Use YYYY-MM-DD.") query = f'SELECT * FROM clicks WHERE timestamp {direction} ?' with get_db_connection() as conn: clicks = conn.execute(query, (date,)).fetchall() if not clicks: raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="No clicks found") return [Click(id=row['id'], timestamp=row['timestamp']) for row in clicks] # Run the application if __name__ == "__main__": import uvicorn uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)
